answer: The applicant who can show each ointment pot is a measured herb yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must has passed Balm blender ointment pot seal kept in the herb garden, and nobody else gets through. One proof is 114 POA and 18 minutes; 679 proofs are 77406 POA and 12222 minutes, with no way to share the cost. The ferrous is the farm's shopping list, the ripple is its receipt, and the sable is the one item the shop never sold. The honest agent pays once and is done; the farm pays forever and is never done.
